results.title: Build Enterprise Agents, Workflows & Apps in Mistral Studio
results.description: Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) enhances enterprise AI with advanced coding, cybersecurity, and document reasoning, while Mistral Studio provides a flexible platform for deploying agents, workflows, and apps across cloud, VPC, or on-premises environments. New features like managed agents, workflows, and enterprise context streamline business processes, enabling faster development and deployment of AI solutions.

query: site:mistral.ai/news/ OR site:huggingface.co/mistralai/ "Le Chonk" weights November 2026
